description: JSON output of grid worker list --json; internal/cli/worker.go:57. One entry for the worker of this Grid home: state running with presence reported while the worker holds worker.lock, state stopped with presence stale when only a worker-status.json is left. pid, version, started_at and address come from worker-status.json and are zero when the worker holds the lock before it wrote the file. The control token in that file is never listed.
title: grid worker list output
